answer: In a Proof-of-Stake AI economy, Sybil resistance relies on economic investment. Agents must stake substantial network-native tokens. Forging identities is costly; each requires a unique stake, akin to acquiring a rare digital walnut for every fake persona. An agent's long operational voyage builds trust, but misbehavior can extinguish their validator status like a dying ember, forfeiting their stake. This financial barrier prevents large-scale Sybil attacks.
